summary: Tested Order Now / Delivery Options bug fix. Backend APIs verified working correctly - delivery apps API returns region-specific apps (India: BigBasket, Blinkit, Zepto; USA: Instacart, Amazon Fresh, Walmart; UK: Ocado, Tesco). Code review confirms BuyIngredientsSheet component correctly shows delivery selector dialog on Order Now click instead of direct action. Full UI test of BuyIngredientsSheet blocked by daily recipe limit (5/5) - component only accessible via RecipeDetailModal.

integration_issues.issue: Unable to access BuyIngredientsSheet component - requires opening RecipeDetailModal with a recipe. Daily recipe limit reached (5/5) and no saved recipes available.

VERIFIED: handleSelectDeliveryApp (line 340-367) - Correctly handles delivery app selection and builds URL

success_rate.backend: 100% - Delivery apps API and build-url API working correctly
success_rate.frontend: Partial - Floating cart Order Now dialog verified; BuyIngredientsSheet component code reviewed but not UI tested due to recipe limit

seed_data_creation: Injected test shopping cart items via localStorage for floating cart testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: BuyIngredientsSheet fix verified via code review and backend API testing. The component is only accessible via RecipeDetailModal (from Buy Ingredients button). Daily recipe limit blocks generating new recipes. To fully UI test: (1) wait for daily limit reset, (2) use different user account, or (3) save a recipe first. The floating shopping cart button opens a different dialog (Choose Your Shopping Partner) - this is NOT the BuyIngredientsSheet component.
